## bestprek and Ruff policy

- Renamed the repository to `ysawa0/bestprek` and updated package names, the Go module, documentation, and copyable configuration.
- Disabled docstrings (`D`, `DOC`), copyright headers (`CPY001`), print bans (`T201`), exception-message formatting (`EM`, `TRY003`), forced absolute imports (`TID252`), required package markers (`INP001`), and unittest-to-pytest conversion (`PT009`, `PT027`) in the shared Ruff hook.
- The shared exclusions work with consumer `ALL` settings and preserve other consumer ignores. Type annotation, correctness, security, and complexity rules remain enabled in the example.
- Added installed-hook fixtures for shared exclusions and retained security checks. The copied example passes without docstrings, copyright headers, or an `__init__.py` file.
